text.en:
Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Lumina.

Standing in a Rift creates Matching Noble Seekers every 5 seconds that seek out allies within 35 metres and apply a buff depending on the type of Rift you stand on. 
Amount of Noble Seekers spawned is equal to Fireteam Size-1, with a minimum of 1 Seeker.

Each time a Noble Seeker applies a buff, the Rift Duration gets extended by 5 seconds.

Healing Rift Seekers heal allies for 75HP and begin Health Regeneration.
Empowering Rift Noble Seekers grant a <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> Damage Increase for 5 seconds.
text.ko:
균열에 서있으면 5초 마다 고귀한 추적기를 생성합니다. 추적기는 35미터 이내에 있는 아군을 찾아가며 균열의 종류에 따라 버프를 부여합니다.

고귀한 추적기가 버프를 부여 할 때 마다 균열의 지속시간이 5초 증가합니다.

치유 균열 추적기는 아군의 체력을 75HP 만큼 회복하고 즉시 체력 재생을 발동합니다.
강화 균열 추적기는 5초간 <pve 35% /> <pvp [20%]> 만큼의 피해 증가를 부여합니다.
text.zh-chs:
为流明被动提升 +30 空中效率。

站在裂缝中每 5 秒会产生一个寻找盟友的高贵追踪弹，在35米范围内寻找盟友，并根据你站立的裂隙的类型给他们施加一个增益效果。
产生的高贵追踪弹数量等于队伍人数减 1，最低为 1 个。

每当一个高贵追踪弹施加一个增益效果，裂隙的持续时间延长 5 秒。

治疗裂隙产生的追踪弹为友军提供 75 点生命值，并开始恢复生命值。
强能裂隙产生的追踪弹为友军提供持续 5 秒的 <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> 伤害增益。

Standing in a Rift or <solar/>Well of Radiance creates Noble Seekers every 5 seconds that seek out allies within 35 meters and apply a buff to them:
• Healing Rift Seeker: restores 75 HP and starts Health Regeneration
• Empowering Rift Seeker: Grants <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> increased damage for 5 seconds (<link Empowering Buff [#DamageBuffs] />)

Noble Seekers grant Noble Rounds to Lumina.

Standing in a Rift or <solar/>Well of Radiance creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies within 40 meters and apply buffs to them:
• Healing Rift Seeker: restores 75 HP and starts Health Regeneration
• Empowering Rift Seeker: grants <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> increased damage for 5 seconds (<link Empowering Buff [#DamageBuffs] />)

Noble seekers spawn at a constant rate based on your Fireteam size.

Buffing allies with Noble Seekers grants Class Ability energy based on your Fireteam size.

Seekers prioritize allies who have not been healed in the last 8 seconds followed by nearby allies. Seekers will not target an ally more than once every 4 seconds.
